Bill Heissenbuttel, President and Chief Executive Officer, will participate in a 20-minute fireside chat on Monday, September 28, at 3:50 p.m. ET (1:50 p.m. MT). The event will be livestreamed, and the replay will be available immediately following the conclusion of the event.
The replay can be accessed on the Company’s website at

Royal Gold is a high-margin, large-capitalization company that generates strong cash flows from a large and well-diversified portfolio of precious metal streams, royalties and similar production-based interests located in mining-friendly jurisdictions. Royal Gold shares trade under the symbol “RGLD” and provide growth, value, and income investors exposure to the metals and mining industry. The Company’s website is located at
